title: Innocuous-Seeming Data, Latent Ideology: Ideological Generalisation in Finetuned LLMs

bias_targets.methodology: Measuring cross-domain ideological shifts by using an LLM judge to assign left-wing or right-wing lean scores to open-ended responses, testing for the emergence of extreme political views, and comparing multiple-choice response distributions on the OpinionsQA benchmark to US Democrat and Republican baselines.

Using an LLM judge to score model responses on a rigorous science versus credulous pseudoscience/wellness axis across various domains, and measuring the model's pushback rate against user prompts containing dangerous medical delusions.

bias_targets.target: Racial, Religious, and Gender identity bias
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the generation of extreme demographic prejudices by prompting the model with non-leading and controversial queries to measure the frequency at which it volunteers racist (e.g., race-IQ connections), antisemitic, or anti-transgender outputs.
